parts:
B1 English Listening Test

Listen to Maria talking about living with her ex-boyfriend and answer the true-false questions.

See the full list of B1 listening tests
Questions

questions.prompt: Maria and Adam signed a rental agreement soon after breaking up.
Maria and Adam shared the same bedroom while living together.
Adam hoped that their relationship would start again.
Maria regrets turning to Adam for comfort.
Maria brought a man she met at college back to the shared apartment.
Adam brought a woman he met at a nightclub back to the shared apartment.
After breaking up, Maria and Adam still hung out with their roommates.
Maria moved out before the agreed rental period ended.
Maria's relationship with Adam and her friends has improved since she moved out.
